evolutionary_history.what_changes: No other chronospecies sits in this 1/1 series, so the delta is across scale at age 0 Ma. Below one activator diffusion length (about 24.1 um) perturbations decay. At 256 um the Schnakenberg linearization selects k_c. A ten-wavelength packet (2560 um) is still not the centimetre NDP wing-bar envelope, and it is not the galliform somite stripe prepattern.

pde: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + S * gamma0 * (a - u + u^2 v)
dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + S * gamma0 * (b - u^2 v)
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = gamma * (Dv f_u + Du g_v) / (2 Du Dv)
equations.boundary_conditions: Periodic on a 1024 um square patch of feather vane. The patch is not the whole bird and not a free-edge follicle.

parameters.note: S multiplies gamma and both diffusivities together. It speeds the clock and does not move k_c. Dv/Du = 10 places only Fourier mode n = 4 inside the unstable band on this grid, which is exactly lambda = 256 um. Stripe anisotropy keeps Dv_y/Du = 2.5 below the Turing threshold so the wavevector lies across the vane.

reported_in_source: Turing 1952: a chemical wavelength is selected where the dispersion relation has positive growth.
Schnakenberg 1979: the two-species kinetics used here.
Murray 1981: the same wavelength mechanism can yield stripes or spots.
Prum and Williamson 2002: within-feather pigment bars, spots and ocelli are reaction-diffusion patterns on the growing vane.
Vickrey et al. 2018: in Columba livia the macroscopic checker versus bar phenotype tracks NDP alleles.
Haupaix et al. 2018: periodic longitudinal coloration in galliforms is a somite prepattern.
reconstructed_here: Parameters are fixed so the linear critical wavelength is exactly 256 um on a 16 um grid. That length is the assigned detail scale. It is not a published rock-dove measurement of 256.000 um.
Diffusion anisotropy is a reconstructed switch between a stripe (bar element) and an isotropic spot lattice at the same k_c. It is not a measured map from NDP onto a diffusion tensor.
does_not_claim: That the centimetre wing bars are a single Turing wavelength.
That galliform somite stripes are this 256 um mode.
A fossil chronospecies, a change in age, or a predecessor Columba morphology. The series length is 1.

specimen.creator: Alan D. Wilson, www.naturespicsonline.com
specimen.description: Feral rock dove in flight, Burnaby Lake Regional Park, Burnaby, BC, Canada. Shows the two dark wing bars of the wild-type phenotype.
